amendments.body: Fix hidden N/C loss in shrimp mortality routing. `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:624-642` multiplies corpse and reserve routing by `death_biomass_to_detritus_fraction` and silently drops the remainder, but there is no explicit export pool/action/budget entry to balance that removed mass. Because live shrimp biomass and reserve are still counted in `crates/tank_core/src/types/budget.rs:239-248` and `crates/tank_core/src/types/budget.rs:324-344`, any value below `1.0` makes total nitrogen/carbon disappear during mortality. Keep the fraction fixed at `1.0` until an explicit export path exists, or add real export accounting.
amendments.rationale: This currently turns a closed-system mortality step into an untracked sink and breaks conservation as soon as the new parameter is set below 1.0.

amendments.body: Validate `death_biomass_to_detritus_fraction` instead of silently clamping it. The new serialized field is introduced in `crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:211-217`, but `crates/tank_core/src/invariants.rs:198-223` never checks it and `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:624-626` coerces out-of-range values into `[0, 1]` at use time. A save can therefore persist `-5.0` or `2.0`, yet runtime behavior becomes `0.0` or `1.0`, so the inspectable state no longer matches the simulation. Add a unit-interval invariant and validation coverage, and remove the runtime clamp.
amendments.rationale: Malformed saves/config should be rejected, not silently normalized into different runtime behavior.

payload.summary: Reviewed the new death-routing/process-param changes plus related plumbing updates. I found two correctness/robustness issues in the new `death_biomass_to_detritus_fraction` path. `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load` and `cargo test -p tank_core --test validation` passed during the review.
